title: 皐月賞の後に・春先の奇跡！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek forces herself to race in the Satsuki Sho and miraculously pulls off a victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives me total credit for her winning what was said to be a hopeless race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then praises me for being an "amazing trainer."
